seoDescription: MCPS 2026–27 calendar for Montgomery County, Maryland: first and last days, no-school dates, early releases, winter and spring breaks, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary:
Regular classes begin for all MCPS students on Tuesday, August 25, 2026. The scheduled last day is Friday, June 11, 2027, with early release. Students have no classes from December 24 through January 1 and from March 26 through April 2.

Classes resume January 4 and April 5. Student Transition Day is August 24 for kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, third graders at elementary schools serving only grades 3–5, and students new to their school or to MCPS.

customSections.label: What MCPS Families Should Know
customSections.content: A few MCPS calendar labels need a little context.

groups.label: Student Transition Day
items: Aug. 24 is for students entering kindergarten, grades 6 and 9; grade 3 at elementary schools serving only grades 3–5; and all students new to a school or MCPS. It is not the regular first day for every student.

groups.label: Staff days with no school for students
items: Students do not attend on Oct. 16, Nov. 2, Jan. 25, March 9 or April 12, although staff have professional development or grading and planning work.

groups.label: Break labels
items: The official calendar divides Winter and Spring Break into holidays, non-instructional days and systemwide closures. The break ranges above combine those labels into the dates when students have no classes.

groups.label: Which calendar applies?
items: This page follows the Traditional School Year Calendar. Arcola Elementary families should use the separate Innovative School Year Calendar linked below.

customSections.label: Early Release and Possible Make-Up Days
customSections.content: These dates can change pickup plans or extend the school year.

groups.label: Early release
items: Sept. 18; Nov. 23–25; Dec. 23; Feb. 26; and the scheduled last day, June 11. Confirm dismissal times with your school.

groups.label: Possible make-up dates
items: April 22, May 17 and June 14–17 may become instructional days if emergencies close schools for three or more days. Do not treat them as guaranteed days off until MCPS confirms the schedule.

whatsNew.title: What’s Different From 2025–26
whatsNew.subtitle: Changes between the two published MCPS Traditional School Year Calendars.
content: The regular first day moves from Aug. 26, 2025 to Aug. 25, 2026.
Student Transition Day moves from Aug. 25, 2025 to Aug. 24, 2026.
Spring Break moves from March 30–April 6, 2026 to March 26–April 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does MCPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Regular classes begin Tuesday, Aug. 25, 2026 on the MCPS Traditional School Year Calendar. Selected students attend Student Transition Day on Monday, Aug. 24.

calendarFaqs.q: Who attends MCPS Student Transition Day?
calendarFaqs.a: Student Transition Day is for students entering kindergarten, grades 6 and 9; grade 3 at elementary schools serving only grades 3–5; and all students new to a school or MCPS.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MCPS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students have no classes Dec. 24, 2026 through Jan. 1, 2027. Dec. 23 is an early-release day, and classes resume Monday, Jan. 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MCPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Students have no classes March 26 through April 2, 2027. Classes resume Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Which days are early-release days for MCPS students?
calendarFaqs.a: The adopted calendar lists early release on Sept. 18; Nov. 23–25; Dec. 23; Feb. 26; and June 11. Confirm exact dismissal times with your school.

calendarFaqs.q: Which MCPS dates can become make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: April 22, May 17 and June 14–17 may become instructional days if emergencies close schools for three or more days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every MCPS school use this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page follows the Traditional School Year Calendar. MCPS publishes a separate 2026–27 Innovative School Year Calendar for Arcola Elementary.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 20, 2026 against the adopted MCPS Traditional School Year Calendar, its accessible table version and Calendar Central.
sourceReviewDetails: We checked every student no-school date, early-release date, marking-period ending and possible make-up date against the April 30 adopted calendar.
We used the MCPS Student Transition Day page for the exact grade and new-student scope.

The graphical calendar PDF contains an inconsistent June note that references June 16 as the last day. Its header, June grid and quarter table identify June 11; the accessible calendar, Calendar Central and MCPS's June 11 event page agree. This page therefore uses June 11 as the scheduled last student day.
The April 30 adopted calendar is the current source for this page; an earlier December 2025 approval announcement contains superseded ending and break dates.
